paragraph: Granville’s composite indicator yields a cautious primary verdict of 44/100, capped at a maximum threshold of 60 due to an active breadth divergence where SPY advances while equal-weight market participation deteriorates (RSP/SPY down -0.59%). Underlying mechanics show ongoing weakness in critical economic bellwethers, driven by relative lags in semiconductors (SOXX/SPY down -0.89%) and transports (IYT/SPY down -0.55%), despite isolated pops in high-beta risk appetite (SPHB/SPLV up +2.67%). The broader macro backdrop provides a temporary buffer via a calm VIX at 15.78 sitting in steep contango, stable high-yield credit spreads at 2.84%, and steady 10-year real yields at 2.41%, though a strengthening Yen at ¥156.68 adds subtle foreign exchange friction. While subdued volatility prevents an immediate macro sell-off, top-heavy index gains masking broken internal market breadth limit true upside momentum. Lean mildly bearish for the session, favoring a fade-on-rallies posture until broad-market participation confirms the benchmark's advance.
